label: Research-inspired self-report items (not an official AQ or diagnostic instrument)

items.text: I prefer clear, predictable routines over spontaneous plans.
I find it easy to read social cues in group conversations.
I notice small details that others often miss.
I enjoy chatting about a wide range of everyday topics.
Loud or busy environments can feel overwhelming for me.
I usually know how to keep a conversation going with someone new.
I can become deeply focused on topics that interest me.
I find it easy to understand figurative language and jokes.
I prefer written instructions when learning something new.
I find social small talk mostly easy and natural.
